rationale.consistency: Mirrors zoekt-git-index flag names and index.Options.Flags; testable execute() is fine. But lock.go has a unix-only build tag with no _other.go fallback, unlike the repo's indexfile_unix/other pattern, so the package won't build elsewhere.
rationale.edge_cases: Duplicates, root-as-repo and .git suffix handled. Missing: no usage printed when no root given; unmatched remove names silently ignored; zoekt.name git config still overrides discovery name; SetTemplatesFromOrigin change alters zoekt-git-index naming when it pre-sets base name.
rationale.scope: Delivers all pieces; gitindex refactor into prepareIndexOptions/PlanIndexGitRepo is larger than minimal and adds exported API, plus an undocumented 'sync' alias, but nothing unrelated.
rationale.readability: Small, well-named functions and files with useful comments. Minor warts: doubled 'zoekt-local-sync:' error prefix, 'Pass -f' reminder printed even with nothing to remove.
rationale.robustness: flock guard is correct and closed properly. Dry run still MkdirAll's index dir and creates a lock file; PlanIndexGitRepo ignores opts.Incremental so -incremental=false is ineffective; unreadable shards skipped silently; compound shards removed wholesale.
rationale.maintainability: Clean split (discover/inventory/lock/sync) and shared flag-set builder; some hidden coupling (removeRecords owns UI text used by sync, plan vs index opens repo twice) but easy to extend.
